creator: nocturne
statement: Dilapidated Slush is the World 3 mini-boss located at the Refrigeration Station map.

creator: nocturne
statement: Bucket of Slush recipe drops from any mob from Refrigeration Station up to Thermonuclear Climb with the Thermisters.

creator: nocturne
statement: Bucket of Slush recipe drops from any mob from Refrigeration Station up to Thermonuclear Climb with the Thermisters.

creator: nocturne
statement: Once you have the recipe craft the Bucket of Slush at the anvil in tab three near the bottom.

creator: nocturne
statement: Bucket of Slush requires 5 Melty Cubes from Frosted Flakes and 20 Snowballs from Snowmen and 5 Iron Bars from Mining.

creator: nocturne
statement: Dilapidated Slush needs at least 1000 accuracy for a 5% hit chance.

creator: nocturne
statement: At least 3000 accuracy is needed for a 100% hit chance on Dilapidated Slush.

creator: nocturne
statement: He hits fairly hard so bring plenty of food.

creator: nocturne
statement: It is not currently possible to gain enough defense to ignore his damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: Summon the boss by dropping the Bucket of Slush on the snow pile in the top right corner of Refrigeration Station.

creator: nocturne
statement: Only one snow pile exists at first and it disappears once you summon the boss.

creator: nocturne
statement: Snow piles respawn on a timer with a minimum of 4 days.

creator: nocturne
statement: Snow piles accumulate so you don't need to fight the boss every 4 days.

creator: nocturne
statement: The respawn timer slows with each pile and up to 10 snow piles can spawn over 69 days.

creator: nocturne
statement: Days only accumulate on days you log into at least one character.

creator: nocturne
statement: For minimum respawn timer log into at least one character each day but you don't need to visit the map.

creator: nocturne
statement: Dilapidated Slush has 12.5 million HP and is a fairly simple fight.

creator: nocturne
statement: He damages you if you walk over him; it hit for 4000 in full Dementia gear.

creator: nocturne
statement: Main drops are Dilapidated Slush Card and Slushy Oval giving skill efficiency and Chizoar keys.

creator: nocturne
statement: Main drops are Dilapidated Slush Card and Slushy Oval giving skill efficiency and Chizoar keys.

creator: nocturne
statement: Slush Skull is a low level Worship Skull slightly better than the crafted version.

creator: nocturne
statement: The main thing to look for from him is the Midnight Stopwatch recipe.

creator: nocturne
statement: Midnight Stopwatch gives 2% fight AFK gains and 3% attack speed.

creator: nocturne
statement: He can also drop coins and time candies and XP balloons and gems.
